name: Crack Rx
kicker: Prescription strength for your concrete's crack problem
headline: Got crack? We fix that.
intro: Hairline, pothole-lite, or a full-blown driveway grand canyon — CrackRx don't judge. We just fill.
about: CrackRx is a dry-fill concrete crack repair compound in an easy-to-handle squeeze bottle. There is no mixing and no mess: pour it into the crack, smooth it off, and mist it with water to activate it. Once it sets it keeps weeds, bugs and water out, and it blends into the surrounding concrete. It is made for driveways and patios, and it is simple enough that anyone can get a professional-looking finish.
